#define j0 _j0
#define j1 _j1
#define jn _jn
#define y0 _y0
#define y1 _y1
#define yn _yn
#define gamma _gamma
#define lgamma _lgamma
#define tgamma _tgamma

#undef y1

#undef lgamma
#undef tgamma

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -5.0000f);
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.8000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- source ---
  tri() {
    glBegin(GL_TRIANGLES);
      glNormal3f(0, 0, 1);
      glVertex3f(-0.3, -0.3, 0);
      glVertex3f(0.3, -0.3, 0);
      glVertex3f(0, 0.4, 0);
    glEnd();
  }

  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  // Pivot rotation: translate out to z=2, rotate, translate back -- the tri
  // swings about a point 2 units away instead of its own origin.
  glColor3f(0.98, 0.46, 0.36);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(0, 0, 2);
    glRotatef(45, 0, 1, 0);
    glTranslatef(0, 0, -2);
    tri();
  glPopMatrix();
  // Animated spin + non-uniform scale, offset to the left.
  glColor3f(0.3, 0.84, 0.8);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(-2, 0, 0);
    glRotatef(3*t, 0, 1, 0);
    glScalef(1.5, 0.5, 1);
    tri();
  glPopMatrix();
  // Rotate-then-translate ring: 6 copies, each rotated then pushed out along
  // the rotated x-axis so they land evenly around a circle.
  glColor3f(0.36, 0.7, 0.98);
  for(i, 0, 6) {
    glPushMatrix();
      glRotatef(i*60, 0, 1, 0);
      glTranslatef(2.5, 0, 0);
      glScalef(0.6, 0.6, 0.6);
      tri();
    glPopMatrix();
  }
  // Translate up + uniform scale.
  glColor3f(0.95, 0.44, 0.66);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(0, 2, 0);
    glScalef(0.8, 0.8, 0.8);
    tri();
  glPopMatrix();
  // Spin in place about the origin.
  glColor3f(0.98, 0.76, 0.36);
  glPushMatrix();
    glRotatef(t*30, 0, 1, 0);
    tri();
  glPopMatrix();
